# zhi2-web-admin
Real estate comprehensive service platform portal; a git submodule of the `苏州市房地产监测V3` main repo at `D:epository\苏州市房地产监测V3\`.

## Repository Context
- Parent main repo: `苏州市房地产监测V3`, local path `D:epository\苏州市房地产监测V3\`
- Recorded as a git submodule with gitlink SHA `d71a36607` matching its HEAD (2026-11-09)
- Parent keeps a numbered error ledger `docs/frontend/common-errors.md` with `E-XXX` entries (E-046 added 2026-11-09)

## Workflow Rules
- Doc edits must be applied in the worktree copy, never the main repo, to keep the main working tree clean
- Build-generated `version.json` in the submodule must be reverted so its git tree stays clean

## Known Issues
- Submodule `.git` pointer with a Chinese path makes git report false "modified content" (` m zhi2-web-admin`); the `.git` files actually hold correct UTF-8
- Pre-existing untracked artifacts and a modified `env/.env` in the main repo are not the agent's and must be left untouched
